# Community Health Evidence Brief

Evercraft public capability ID: community-health-evidence-brief-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://systemiacommandcenters.com

## Use this when

- community health data
- county health evidence brief
- public health grant research
- health indicators for a community
- public health planning data

## Problem

Community-health planning and grant work requires many public indicators assembled into one sourced, understandable picture.

## Inputs

Geography, planning/grant question, target population where appropriate and requested public indicators.

## Outputs

Geography-specific public-health evidence brief with indicator provenance, gaps, comparisons and uncertainty.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Current hypothesis $250-$2,500 per brief; not auto-quotable yet.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Public-health research/education only, not medical advice or diagnosis. Paid scope requires explicit confirmation.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, or payment state.
